description: List every project this user owns, each with its display name, key (a folder path or brilliant-cloud:// key), backing (local/synced/cloud), open state (active tab / background tab / closed), canvas count when known, and whether it is published, with its url, visibility, audience and your role where known. Pass a name or key from this list as the `project` argument on `init` or any canvas tool to work in a project other than the one on screen, including a closed one.
name: list_projects
